Flumph_Wildmagic
Spectral Flumphs are a non-playable race and Aberration that can be summoned by Wild Magic Barbarians using  Wild Magic: Intangible Spirit (Activate).

The summoned flumph explodes at the end of the Barbarian's turn, dealing 1d6⁠⁠Force damage to each creature within 2 m (7 ft).
